SHARED-F-2-S90.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Routing Integration
SHARED-F-2-S90.description: Expose consent capture, retrieval, and escalation via API endpoints and integrate with tool_router to ensure all consent-related actions are validated and dispatched through the allowlist tool framework.

SHARED-F-2-S91.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
SHARED-F-2-S91.description: Integrate consent framework with lead capture and unknown question services to enforce Tier 2 consent before storing identifiable data and ensure Tier 1 de-identified handling otherwise.

SHARED-F-2-S92.title: Consent Audit Logging and Persistence
SHARED-F-2-S92.description: Implement persistent storage and audit logging for consent decisions, including tier selection, timestamps, session linkage, and de-identification status, ensuring traceability for compliance.

SHARED-F-2-S93.title: Frontend Consent Prompt and Tier Selection Handling
SHARED-F-2-S93.description: Implement frontend interaction patterns for consent prompts, including Tier 1 default handling and Tier 2 explicit opt-in, ensuring proper request/response handling with backend APIs.
